notes: HUNT H2 pair 7 (heat 2660, nontoken-census recursion + attack/block branch). Basri -2 armed; Wolf attacks -> the -2 trigger's census 'whenever one or more NONTOKEN creatures attack, create THAT MANY' sees exactly ONE nontoken attacker (the Soldier token it creates also attacks, tapped, but must NOT inflate or re-fire the census - token-exclusion branch, CR 603.3 watches the declare-attackers event only + printed 'nontoken', CR 603.2). Elder Gargaroth (seat 1) blocks: its BLOCK branch of 'attacks or blocks, choose one' fires (default first mode = create 3/3 Beast token, elder_gargaroth precedent). Gargaroth's printed trample is inert while blocking (CR 702.8a applies to attacking creatures) -> seat 0 takes nothing; Wolf takes all 6 and dies (CR 704.5s); the unblocked 1/1 Soldier ticks seat 1 for 1. Damage ledger shows only the surviving Gargaroth's 2 marks (the 16a mark ledger resets with the dying creature). Basri loyalty 3-2=1. Tokens: Soldier 1 (seat 0's, keyless) + Beast 1 (seat 1's).
